mapper.update: UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'DISPATCHED', dispatched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING')

UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'RETRYING')

UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'RETURNED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{errorMessage}, 1000), next_attempt_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'CONFIRMED', 'RETRYING')

UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{errorMessage}, 1000), next_attempt_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'RETRYING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, message_type, exchange_name, routing_key, payload_json, status, retry_count, last_error, next_attempt_time, dispatched_at, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM mq_message_status WHERE retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( (status IN ('FAILED', 'RETURNED') AND (next_attempt_time IS NULL OR next_attempt_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) OR (status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'RETRYING') AND updated_at <= #{staleBefore}) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'RETRYING', last_error = 'compensation claimed', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( (status IN ('FAILED', 'RETURNED') AND (next_attempt_time IS NULL OR next_attempt_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) OR (status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'RETRYING') AND updated_at <= #{staleBefore}) )
UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'DISPATCHED', dispatched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RETRYING'

UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{errorMessage}, 1000), next_attempt_time = #{nextAttemptTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RETRYING'
